name: MortarPhys
description: IPhys class containing parameters of MortarMat. Used by Law2_ScGeom_MortarPhys_Lourenco.

attributes.name: ellAspect
attributes.description: aspect ratio of elliptical 'cap'. Value >1 means the ellipse is longer along normal stress axis.

attributes.name: frictDissip
attributes.description: frictional energy dissipation in the contact (this value is updated by contact laws applicable to FrictPhys - currently only

attributes.name: neverDamage
attributes.description: If true, interactions remain elastic regardless stresses

attributes.name: normalForce
attributes.description: Normal force after previous step (in global coordinates), as sustained by particle #2 (from particle #1).

attributes.name: shearForce
attributes.description: Shear force after previous step (in global coordinates), as sustained by particle #2 (from particle #1).

methods.name: failureCondition
methods.description: Failure condition from normal stress and norm of shear stress (false=elastic, true=damaged)
